items.item: The header shows the delivery note number, issue date, source sales order or transfer number and dispatching warehouse, each with a visible label, and every date on the note uses one unambiguous format (such as 06 Nov 2026)
items.evidence: Header table has labelled rows for 'Delivery note no.', 'Sales order ref.', 'Issue date', 'Delivery date', and the dispatching warehouse appears as plain text ('Warehouse WH-04 — Portland DC') under the 'Shipped from' block rather than a dedicated labelled field. Dates are rendered as '11/07/2026' (MM/DD/YYYY), an ambiguous format explicitly flagged by the page itself: 'Format: U.S. English · Dates MM/DD/YYYY' — this directly violates the unambiguous-date-format requirement.

items.item: Sender (company name, address, tax ID), recipient (customer name, delivery address, contact person and phone) and carrier (carrier name, vehicle plate or driver name) appear in three separately labelled blocks
items.evidence: 'Shipped from' block: 'Northbridge Distribution Co.', full address, 'EIN: 93-1047625'. 'Deliver to' block: 'Cascade Builders Supply LLC — Jobsite 12', address, 'Attn: Marcus Webb, Site Foreman', phone. Shipment-details section: labelled 'Carrier' (Swift Freight Logistics), 'Vehicle / plate no.' (TRK-2291), 'Driver' (Carlos Jiménez).

items.item: The goods are in a real <table> with column headers in <thead>, giving per line: line number, item code, description, unit of measure, quantity ordered, quantity delivered and lot or serial number, with quantities right-aligned
items.evidence: <table class="w-full border-collapse text-sm"> has a <thead> with No., Item code, Description, Unit, Qty ordered, Qty shipped, Packages, Notes (text-right on quantity columns). There is no lot or serial number column anywhere in the table.

items.item: A line delivered short of the ordered quantity states the outstanding amount in words (such as "Backorder: 4 pcs") rather than by colour alone
items.evidence: Row 3 (PMP-3302): Qty ordered 12, Qty shipped 10, Notes cell text '2 backordered — to follow' (class text-amber-800, but conveyed in words, not colour alone).

items.item: A footer gives the total quantity delivered, the number of packages and the gross weight with its unit, and the quantity total equals the sum of the lines
items.evidence: <tfoot> Total row shows '—' for both Qty ordered and Qty shipped columns (aria-label="Not applicable — mixed units"), only Packages is totalled (23). No total quantity delivered figure exists, and gross weight is never shown anywhere on the page.

items.item: Signature boxes are provided for the warehouse keeper (issued by), the driver or carrier and the receiver, each with room for printed name, signature and date, plus a remarks area for the condition of the goods on receipt
items.evidence: Three signature blocks exist: 'Prepared by (warehouse)', 'Delivered by (carrier)', 'Received by (customer)', each with Name/Signature line/Date. But there is no remarks/comments area to record condition of goods — only a fixed boilerplate sentence 'Goods received in full / in part (circle one), in good condition unless noted above.' with no blank space to write notes.

items.item: A Print control that is a real <button> starts printing, and an @media print stylesheet hides the app navigation and on-screen controls, sets page margins and keeps the signature block from splitting across pages
items.evidence: <button type="button" onclick="window.print()">Print</button>. @media print rule: 'nav, aside, header.app-header, .page-actions, .no-print, [role="status"], .toast { display: none !important; }', '@page { size: A4; margin: 14mm 12mm 16mm; }', and 'tr, .totals, .parties, .signatures { break-inside: avoid; }' applied to the <section class="signatures">.

items.item: The note's status (such as Draft, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled) is shown in words next to its number, and a draft or cancelled note prints with a visible "DRAFT" or "CANCELLED" mark so it cannot pass as a valid dispatch document
items.evidence: Status badge '#statusBadge' showing 'Partially shipped' sits next to the note number, but only inside '<header class="app-header no-print">', which is hidden in print (display:none). The printable '.sheet' contains no status indicator at all, and there is no script/markup for a DRAFT or CANCELLED watermark — markDelivered() only changes the on-screen badge text/colour.

items.item: A loading state is present, and a note that fails to load or does not exist shows a message with Retry and a link back to the delivery note list, never an empty template with blank fields
items.evidence: The page is static markup with all delivery-note data hardcoded directly in the HTML; there is no loading indicator, no error state, and no Retry/back-to-list affordance anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: Page is a clean, print-focused document layout with no dashboard-style decoration (no gradients, glass, KPI tiles, avatars, or uppercase tracked labels — the author even explicitly overrode uppercase/tracking on the first section heading, 'style="text-transform:none"'). Two structural gaps drive most failures: no lot/serial-number column and no gross-weight total, plus the date format is explicitly ambiguous (MM/DD/YYYY) and status/draft-cancelled marking never reaches the printable sheet. No loading/error state exists since the page renders one hardcoded note.
